answer: Unrepeatable challenge sprial. Each identity must solve a fresh, locally generated puzzle whose answer is a deterministic function of its own prior answer, forming a spiral of dependent outputs. A yarrow-seeded nonce ensures uniqueness per registration round. Answers are verified against the derived chain, so replay or copying fails. The per-identity cost is the compute and unique entropy an attacker must expend for every clone, since one opal of reusable proof cannot be shared across identities.
